answer.rationale: Do not match the competitor with broad discounting: the recovered 40% SMB discount increased qualified revenue short term but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, undermining sustainable revenue. Test stronger in-product value and activation messaging for price-sensitive SMB accounts, using the established week-one engagement lift as the basis while monitoring churn, retention, and qualified revenue. Reassess the conflicting promotional-pricing memory when verification is available.
